messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: latency.slo.p95 > 1200ms for routing-group: model-serving-eu (auto-reroute engaged)

luis (oncall): I'm on it. Paging SRE + runtime. Which customers impacted?

amanda: Seeing a spike across eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 fallbacks. p95 jumped to ~1.8s at 11:07 UTC. A lot of requests are landing on fallback variant `v1-int8` which looks slower for long contexts.

raj: quick heads up — routing policy hysteresis is set to 10s in prod routing-config v3.4. That is too aggressive; fleet oscillates and triggers repeated reroutes. Suspect fallback mapping also includes a mis-tagged variant (v1-int8) marked as "compatible" for longer contexts.

emily: @luis can we disable auto-reroute while we triage? customers are seeing increased latency and a few support tickets already.

jeff: I can flip the routing hold to 120s for the group. Doing a controlled change now.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by jeff: POST /infra/configs/routing/routing-group/model-serving-eu/hold -> 120s (change_id: cfg-9876)

jeff: change applied. curl snippet I ran:
```
curl -X PATCH https://internal-api/redwood/configs/routing/model-serving-eu \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"auto_reroute_hold_sec":120}'
```

mira (cs): we've got two tickets from enterprise customers complaining about slow responses since the start of the spike. Notified CS lead.

amanda: Mitigation plan: 1) hold auto-reroute (done), 2) pin routing fallback to v2-small for long-context traffic, 3) patch fallback tags to avoid v1-int8 promotion. I'll roll the pin now.

raj: root cause summary so far: fallback policy allows variants with incompatible performance profiles to be considered compatible. When p95 crosses threshold, policy rapidly flips between regions/variants. That promotes v1-int8 which has quantization regressions at >1024 tokens -> higher decode time.

amanda: Pinned fallback for routing-group to `v2-small` for contexts > 1024 tokens. Command:
```
internalctl routing set-fallback model-serving-eu --context-gt 1024 --variant v2-small --reason "incident 2645001234"
```

deploy-bot: config change applied: fallback pin for model-serving-eu (change_id: cfg-9877)

raj: I'll submit a follow-up patch to routing engine to enforce a perf compatibility check during candidate selection. Also adding a unit test for long-context throughput.

luis (oncall): Assigning P1. PagerDuty incident created: PD-4449. Notifying Product/CS for customer comms. @emily can you draft a short message with ETA and workaround?

emily: Drafting now. Suggest: shortnote to affected customers explaining temporary increase in latency, mitigation (pinned to v2-small), and estimated 30-45m for full stabilization. Will post in status once SLO holds for 15m.

amanda: p95 trending down — 11:25 UTC ~ 720ms, 11:30 UTC ~ 480ms. No more region switches in the last 3 minutes. CPU on v2-small stable.

mira (cs): customers acknowledged the workaround and appreciate the quick response. One customer requested a post-mortem.

raj: I've opened a PR to add a compatibility gate + hysteresis default bump to 60s and an integration test. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/compare/fix-compat-gate

jeff: rolling the hysteresis default bump via infra config after PR is merged. Good catch.

luis (oncall): marking incident as mitigated but keeping page open for follow-ups and postmortem. Great teamwork. :thumbsup:

amanda: I'll own the postmortem and include timeline, root cause (fallback-tag mismatch + too-low hysteresis), impact (p95 spikes for ~30m, several enterprise customers affected), and action items (compatibility gate, config defaults, monitoring alert refinement).

deploy-bot: Incident PD-4449 status changed -> mitigated

mira (cs): please share postmortem draft with CS so we can coordinate customer communications.

luis (oncall): Closing thread once postmortem link is attached. Thanks all.
